After weeks of testing, WhatsApp has officially rolled out a brand-new in-chat search button for iPhone users. Here are the details.

The button appears as you scroll up

Earlier last month, WhatsApp began testing a new search button placed in the bottom-right corner of the chat interface, making it easier for users to launch the search function.

Before this update, users who wanted to search within a conversation had to first tap the contact or group name at the top of the chat, then select the search option from the chat info page, and finally return to the main conversation screen to enter their query.

By comparison, the in-chat search button streamlines the entire process, allowing users to start a search instantly without leaving the conversation.

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp has now officially launched the in-chat search button, but its position differs from that during the testing period.

WABetaInfo reports as follows:

WABetaInfo points out that the new shortcut works the same way whether in individual chats, group chats, or channels. In all three cases, when the user scrolls up in a conversation or channel, the button appears near the top of the screen; when the user scrolls back down to the bottom, the button disappears.

As is the case with most WhatsApp feature rollouts, the new search button may take some time to reach all users.
